news.models module

Normalised news, subscription and integration models.

The schema is in third normal form: each fact (an author, a publisher, a subscription, a delivery receipt) is stored once and referenced by key.

class news.models.User(*args, **kwargs)[source]

Bases: AbstractUser

Custom user with a newsroom role and reader subscriptions.

The role decides which Django group the user belongs to (kept in sync by news.signals). Reader-only fields are the two subscription relations; journalist-only fields are the reverse articles and newsletters relations. The properties below expose each set of fields and return None when the user has a different role, as the brief requires.

publisher_subscriptions

Accessor to the related objects manager on the forward and reverse sides of a many-to-many relation.

In the example:

class Pizza(Model):
    toppings = ManyToManyField(Topping, related_name='pizzas')

Pizza.toppings and Topping.pizzas are ManyToManyDescriptor instances.

Most of the implementation is delegated to a dynamically defined manager class built by create_forward_many_to_many_manager() defined below.

property reader_publishers

Return subscribed publishers for readers, otherwise None.

property reader_journalists

Return subscribed journalists for readers, otherwise None.

property independent_articles

Return a journalist’s independent articles, otherwise None.

Independent articles are those with no publisher.

property independent_newsletters

Return a journalist’s independent newsletters, else None.

property is_editor

True if the user has the editor role or is in the Editor group.

Checking the group as well means an administrator can grant editor rights through Django’s group admin.

class news.models.Article(*args, **kwargs)[source]

Bases: Model

A news story written by a journalist.

publisher is optional: an empty publisher means an independent article by the journalist, otherwise it is publisher content. Only an editor may set approved; editing a story increments revision and sends it back for review.

class news.models.ApprovalDelivery(*args, **kwargs)[source]

Bases: Model

Tracks notification progress for one approved article revision.

Email and the API log are recorded separately so a failed channel can be retried without repeating the one that succeeded.
